Class NvidiaModel

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.agi.provider.AbstractModel
uno.anahata.asi.openai.compatible.OpenAiCompatibleModel
uno.anahata.asi.nvidia.NvidiaModel
public class NvidiaModel extends OpenAiCompatibleModel
Concrete model implementation for NVIDIA NIM microservices endpoints.

Handles reasoning content extraction for NVIDIA NIM models, auto-detecting whether thoughts are returned via reasoning_content fields or <think> tags.

anahata
